recognize_zh: 細胞略大於紅血球，圓核染色質濃縮成塊、無核仁，周圍有一圈稍寬的淡藍色細胞質且無顆粒，是正常的靜止淋巴球。
features: Small round cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with a slightly wider rim of pale blue cytoplasm than the smallest lymphocytes
Round nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm is agranular with a slightly irregular outer border; normal background red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small round lymphocyte slightly larger than adjacent red cells, with a round nucleus composed of coarse clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus. There is a narrow rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal resting lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are larger with more abundant cytoplasm showing peripheral basophilia that molds around red cells, and often more open chromatin.
Individual CLL cells look similar, so distinction relies on an absolute monoclonal CD5+/CD23+ B-lymphocytosis rather than single-cell morphology.
LGLs are larger with abundant pale cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules.
